inputs.prompt: Hand-drawn Japanese 2D gothic anime, stable ink outlines, broad drawn hair shapes, matte skin and hard cel shading. This is several days later in the warm sunny market; clean restored clothes and golden cream daylight are intentional. Preserve identities, screen positions, bench and existing bowl shapes. No night lighting, cathedral, CGI, gloss, extra characters, extra spoons, random cuts or orbit. Keep this intimate fixed lower-face close-up, no need to reveal the eyes. Claude raises the existing SINGLE silver spoon with its small bite of rice to her lips. Lips part slightly, take the rice ONCE, close gently, and the same now-empty spoon withdraws downward. A subtle swallow and relaxed mouth corners follow, with a brief calm hold. No second eating cycle, repeated chewing, oversized open mouth or new bowl in the crop. Keep the supporting hand anatomy and spoon rigid and continuous. Warm light and clean veil remain unchanged.
